pages.text: A new world starts with $(thing)500 storage capacity$() by default. The game adds up the weight of all stacks in the backpack. Hotbar and equipment have separate space.

pages.title: Footprint
pages.text: $(thing)Weight per item$() is the footprint factor divided by the item's regular maximum stack size, rounded up. The factor is 32 by default.$(br2)$(li)Cobblestone (normally stacks to 64) weighs 1.$(li)Empty buckets (normally stack to 16) weigh 2.$(li)Tools that normally stack to 1 weigh 32.

pages.title: Item Variants
pages.text: Weight normally adds across every item in storage. Different damage, names, enchantments, or other item data can make two stacks separate variants. $(l:biginventory:gear/endant)Endant$(/l) discounts quantities beyond the first stack of a variant.
